# apple_beta_build_localization (Resource)

Sets a build's "What to Test" text for one locale. A build has one localization per locale.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_build" "latest" {
  app_id              = data.apple_app.example.id
  pre_release_version = "1.2.0"
  latest              = true
}

resource "apple_beta_build_localization" "en" {
  build_id  = data.apple_build.latest.id
  locale    = "en-US"
  whats_new = "Try the new checkout flow."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`. Changing it creates a new localization.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`. Changing it creates a new localization.

### Optional

- `whats_new` (String) What testers should test in this build.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_build_localization.en
  identity = {
    id = "6d5c4b3a-2f1e-4d0c-9b8a-7f6e5d4c3b2a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_beta_build_localization.en 6d5c4b3a-2f1e-4d0c-9b8a-7f6e5d4c3b2a
```
